versos.hebraico: ה֚וֹי אֲרִיאֵ֣ל אֲרִיאֵ֔ל קִרְיַ֖ת חָנָ֣ה דָוִ֑ד סְפ֥וּ שָׁנָ֛ה עַל־שָׁנָ֖ה חַגִּ֥ים יִנְקֹֽפוּ׃

controles.web: Woe to Ariel! Ariel, the city where David encamped! Add year to year; let the feasts come around;
controles.kjv: Woe to Ariel, to Ariel, the city where David dwelt! add ye year to year; let them kill sacrifices.
controles.livre: Ai de Ariel! Ariel, a cidade em que Davi se acampou. Acrescentai ano a ano, completem-se as festas de sacrifícios.

versos.hebraico: וַהֲצִיק֖וֹתִי לַֽאֲרִיאֵ֑ל וְהָיְתָ֤ה תַֽאֲנִיָּה֙ וַֽאֲנִיָּ֔ה וְהָ֥יְתָה לִּ֖י כַּאֲרִיאֵֽל׃

controles.web: then I will distress Ariel, and there will be mourning and lamentation. She shall be to me as an altar hearth.
controles.kjv: Yet I will distress Ariel, and there shall be heaviness and sorrow: and it shall be unto me as Ariel.
controles.livre: Contudo oprimirei a Ariel, e haverá pranto e tristeza; e ela me será como um altar de sacrifício.

versos.hebraico: וְחָנִ֥יתִי כַדּ֖וּר עָלָ֑יִךְ וְצַרְתִּ֤י עָלַ֨יִךְ֙ מֻצָּ֔ב וַהֲקִֽימֹתִ֥י עָלַ֖יִךְ מְצֻרֹֽת׃

controles.web: I will encamp against you all around you, and will lay siege against you with posted troops. I will raise siege works against you.
controles.kjv: And I will camp against thee round about, and will lay siege against thee with a mount, and I will raise forts against thee.
controles.livre: Pois eu me acamparei ao seu redor, e te cercarei com rampas,  e levantarei cercos contra ti.

versos.hebraico: וְשָׁפַלְתְּ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ תְּדַבֵּ֔רִי וּמֵֽעָפָ֖ר תִּשַּׁ֣ח אִמְרָתֵ֑ךְ וְֽ֠הָיָה כְּא֤וֹב מֵאֶ֨רֶץ֙ קוֹלֵ֔ךְ וּמֵעָפָ֖ר אִמְרָתֵ֥ךְ תְּצַפְצֵֽף׃

controles.web: You will be brought down, and will speak out of the ground. Your speech will mumble out of the dust. Your voice will be as of one who has a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and your speech will whisper out of the dust.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt be brought down, and shalt speak out of the ground, and thy speech shall be low out of the dust, and thy voice shall be, as of one that hath a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and thy speech shall whisper out of the dust.
controles.livre: Então serás abatida; falarás junto ao chão, e tua fala será fraca desde o pó da terra, como a de um morto, e tua fala sussurrará desde o pó da terra.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֛ה כְּאָבָ֥ק דַּ֖ק הֲמ֣וֹן זָרָ֑יִךְ וּכְמֹ֤ץ עֹבֵר֙ הֲמ֣וֹן עָֽרִיצִ֔ים וְהָיָ֖ה לְפֶ֥תַע פִּתְאֹֽם׃

controles.web: But the multitude of your foes will be like fine dust, and the multitude of the ruthless ones like chaff that blows away. Yes, it will be in an instant, suddenly.
controles.kjv: Moreover the multitude of thy strangers shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the terrible ones shall be as chaff that passeth away: yea, it shall be at an instant suddenly.
controles.livre: E a multidão de teus adversários  será como o pó fino, e a multidão dos violentos como a palha que passa; e isto acontecerá de repente, em um momento.

versos.hebraico: מֵעִ֨ם יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ תִּפָּקֵ֔ד בְּרַ֥עַם וּבְרַ֖עַשׁ וְק֣וֹל גָּד֑וֹל סוּפָה֙ וּסְעָרָ֔ה וְלַ֖הַב אֵ֥שׁ אוֹכֵלָֽה׃

controles.web: She will be visited by Yahweh of Armies with thunder, with earthquake, with great noise, with whirlwind and storm, and with the flame of a devouring fire.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt be visited of the Lord of hosts with thunder, and with earthquake, and great noise, with storm and tempest, and the flame of devouring fire.
controles.livre: Pelo SENHOR dos exércitos serás visitada com trovões, terremotos, e grande ruído; com impetuoso vento, tempestade, e labareda de fogo consumidor.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֗ה כַּֽחֲלוֹם֙ חֲז֣וֹן לַ֔יְלָה הֲמוֹן֙ כָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם הַצֹּבְאִ֖ים עַל־אֲרִיאֵ֑ל וְכָל־צֹבֶ֨יהָ֙ וּמְצֹ֣דָתָ֔הּ וְהַמְּצִיקִ֖ים לָֽהּ׃

controles.web: The multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all who fight against her and her stronghold, and who distress her, will be like a dream, a vision of the night.
controles.kjv: And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all that fight against her and her munition, and that distress her, shall be as a dream of a night vision.
controles.livre: E tal como um sonho ou visão noturna, assim será a multidão de todas as nações que batalharão contra Ariel, assim também como todos os que lutaram contra ela e seus muros, e a oprimiram.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֡ה כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ יַחֲלֹ֨ם הָרָעֵ֜ב וְהִנֵּ֣ה אוֹכֵ֗ל וְהֵקִיץ֮ וְרֵיקָ֣ה נַפְשׁוֹ֒ וְכַאֲשֶׁ֨ר יַחֲלֹ֤ם הַצָּמֵא֙ וְהִנֵּ֣ה שֹׁתֶ֔ה וְהֵקִיץ֙ וְהִנֵּ֣ה עָיֵ֔ף וְנַפְשׁ֖וֹ שׁוֹקֵקָ֑ה כֵּ֣ן יִֽהְיֶ֗ה הֲמוֹן֙ כָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם הַצֹּבְאִ֖ים עַל־הַ֥ר צִיּֽוֹן׃ס

controles.web: It will be like when a hungry man dreams, and behold, he eats; but he awakes, and his hunger isn’t satisfied; or like when a thirsty man dreams, and behold, he drinks; but he awakes, and behold, he is faint, and he is still thirsty. The multitude of all the nations that fight against Mount Zion will be like that.
controles.kjv: It shall even be as when an hungry man dreameth, and, behold, he eateth; but he awaketh, and his soul is empty: or as when a thirsty man dreameth, and, behold, he drinketh; but he awaketh, and, behold, he is faint, and his soul hath appetite: so shall the multitude of all the nations be, that fight against mount Zion.
controles.livre: Será também como um faminto que sonha estar comendo, porém, ao acordar, sua alma está vazia; ou como o sedento que sonha estar bebendo, porém, ao acordar, eis que está fraco e com sede na alma; assim será toda a multidão de nações que batalharem contra o monte de Sião.

versos.hebraico: הִתְמַהְמְה֣וּ וּתְמָ֔הוּ הִשְׁתַּֽעַשְׁע֖וּ וָשֹׁ֑עוּ שָֽׁכְר֣וּ וְלֹא־יַ֔יִן נָע֖וּ וְלֹ֥א שֵׁכָֽר׃

controles.web: Pause and wonder! Blind yourselves and be blind! They are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.
controles.kjv: Stay yourselves, and wonder; cry ye out, and cry: they are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.
controles.livre: Parai, e maravilhai-vos; cegai-vos, e sede cegos! Estão bêbados, mas não de vinho; cambaleiam, mas não por bebida alcoólica.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־נָסַ֨ךְ עֲלֵיכֶ֤ם יְהוָה֙ ר֣וּחַ תַּרְדֵּמָ֔ה וַיְעַצֵּ֖ם אֶת־עֵֽינֵיכֶ֑ם אֶת־הַנְּבִיאִ֛ים וְאֶת־רָאשֵׁיכֶ֥ם הַחֹזִ֖ים כִּסָּֽה׃

controles.web: For Yahweh has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep, and has closed your eyes, the prophets; and he has covered your heads, the seers.
controles.kjv: For the Lord hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep, and hath closed your eyes: the prophets and your rulers, the seers hath he covered.
controles.livre: Pois o SENHOR derramou sobre vós espírito de sono profundo; ele fechou vossos olhos (os profetas), e cobriu vossos cabeças (os videntes).

versos.hebraico: וַתְּהִ֨י לָכֶ֜ם חָז֣וּת הַכֹּ֗ל כְּדִבְרֵי֮ הַסֵּ֣פֶר הֶֽחָתוּם֒ אֲשֶֽׁר־יִתְּנ֣וּ אֹת֗וֹ אֶל־יוֹדֵ֥עַ הספר לֵאמֹ֖ר קְרָ֣א נָא־זֶ֑ה וְאָמַר֙ לֹ֣א אוּכַ֔ל כִּ֥י חָת֖וּם הֽוּא׃

controles.web: All vision has become to you like the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one who is educated, saying, “Read this, please”; and he says, “I can’t, for it is sealed:”
controles.kjv: And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I cannot; for it is sealed:
controles.livre: E toda visão vos será como as palavras de um livro selado que, quando se dá a um letrado, dizendo: Lê isto, por favor;Esse dirá: Não posso, porque está selado.

versos.hebraico: וְנִתַּ֣ן הַסֵּ֗פֶר עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־יָדַ֥ע סֵ֛פֶר לֵאמֹ֖ר קְרָ֣א נָא־זֶ֑ה וְאָמַ֕ר לֹ֥א יָדַ֖עְתִּי סֵֽפֶר׃ס

controles.web: and the book is delivered to one who is not educated, saying, “Read this, please”; and he says, “I can’t read.”
controles.kjv: And the book is delivered to him that is not learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I am not learned.
controles.livre: E quando se dá o livro a alguém que não saiba ler, dizendo: Lê isto, por favor; Esse dirá: Não sei ler.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲדֹנָ֗י יַ֚עַן כִּ֤י נִגַּשׁ֙ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה בְּפִ֤יו וּבִשְׂפָתָיו֙ כִּבְּד֔וּנִי וְלִבּ֖וֹ רִחַ֣ק מִמֶּ֑נִּי וַתְּהִ֤י יִרְאָתָם֙ אֹתִ֔י מִצְוַ֥ת אֲנָשִׁ֖ים מְלֻמָּדָֽה׃

controles.web: The Lord said, “Because this people draws near with their mouth and with their lips to honor me, but they have removed their heart far from me, and their fear of me is a commandment of men which has been taught;
controles.kjv: Wherefore the Lord said, Forasmuch as this people draw near me with their mouth, and with their lips do honour me, but have removed their heart far from me, and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men:
controles.livre: Pois o Senhor disse: Visto que este povo se aproxima de mim com a boca, e me honram com seus lábios, porém seus corações se afastam de mim, e fingem que me temem por meio de mandamentos humanos que aprendem;

versos.hebraico: לָכֵ֗ן הִנְנִ֥י יוֹסִ֛ף לְהַפְלִ֥יא אֶת־הָֽעָם־הַזֶּ֖ה הַפְלֵ֣א וָפֶ֑לֶא וְאָֽבְדָה֙ חָכְמַ֣ת חֲכָמָ֔יו וּבִינַ֥ת נְבֹנָ֖יו תִּסְתַּתָּֽר׃ס

controles.web: therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvelous work among this people, even a marvelous work and a wonder; and the wisdom of their wise men will perish, and the understanding of their prudent men will be hidden.”
controles.kjv: Therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people, even a marvellous work and a wonder: for the wisdom of their wise men shall perish, and the understanding of their prudent men shall be hid.
controles.livre: Por isso, eis que continuarei a fazer coisas espantosas com este povo; coisas espantosas e surpreendentes; porque a sabedoria de seus sábios perecerá, e a inteligência dos inteligentes se esconderá.

versos.hebraico: ה֛וֹי הַמַּעֲמִיקִ֥ים מֵֽיהוָ֖ה לַסְתִּ֣ר עֵצָ֑ה וְהָיָ֤ה בְמַחְשָׁךְ֙ מַֽעֲשֵׂיהֶ֔ם וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ מִ֥י רֹאֵ֖נוּ וּמִ֥י יוֹדְעֵֽנוּ׃

controles.web: Woe to those who deeply hide their counsel from Yahweh, and whose works are in the dark, and who say, “Who sees us?” and “Who knows us?”
controles.kjv: Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the Lord, and their works are in the dark, and they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?
controles.livre: Ai dos que querem se esconder do SENHOR, encobrindo suas intenções; e fazem suas obras às escuras, e dizem: Quem nos vê? Quem nos conhece?

versos.hebraico: הַ֨פְכְּכֶ֔ם אִם־כְּחֹ֥מֶר הַיֹּצֵ֖ר יֵֽחָשֵׁ֑ב כִּֽי־יֹאמַ֨ר מַעֲשֶׂ֤ה לְעֹשֵׂ֨הוּ֙ לֹ֣א עָשָׂ֔נִי וְיֵ֛צֶר אָמַ֥ר לְיוֹצְר֖וֹ לֹ֥א הֵבִֽין׃

controles.web: You turn things upside down! Should the potter be thought to be like clay; that the thing made should say about him who made it, “He didn’t make me”; or the thing formed say of him who formed it, “He has no understanding?”
controles.kjv: Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter’s clay: for shall the work say of him that made it, He made me not? or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it, He had no understanding?
controles.livre: Como é grande vossa perversão! Pode, por acaso, o oleiro ser considerado igual ao barro? Pode a obra dizer de seu criador que “ele não me fez”? Ou o vaso formado dizer de seu formador: “Ele nada entende”?

versos.hebraico: הֲלוֹא־עוֹד֙ מְעַ֣ט מִזְעָ֔ר וְשָׁ֥ב לְבָנ֖וֹן לַכַּרְמֶ֑ל וְהַכַּרְמֶ֖ל לַיַּ֥עַר יֵחָשֵֽׁב׃

controles.web: Isn’t it yet a very little while, and Lebanon will be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field will be regarded as a forest?
controles.kjv: Is it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?
controles.livre: Por acaso não será que ,daqui a pouco tempo, o Líbano se tornará um campo fértil? E o campo fértil será considerado uma floresta?

versos.hebraico: וְשָׁמְע֧וּ בַיּוֹם־הַה֛וּא הַחֵרְשִׁ֖ים דִּבְרֵי־סֵ֑פֶר וּמֵאֹ֣פֶל וּמֵחֹ֔שֶׁךְ עֵינֵ֥י עִוְרִ֖ים תִּרְאֶֽינָה׃

controles.web: In that day, the deaf will hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind will see out of obscurity and out of darkness.
controles.kjv: And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity, and out of darkness.
controles.livre: E naquele dia os surdos ouvirão as palavras do livro; e os olhos dos cegos desde a escuridão e desde as trevas as verão.

versos.hebraico: וְיָסְפ֧וּ עֲנָוִ֛ים בַּֽיהוָ֖ה שִׂמְחָ֑ה וְאֶבְיוֹנֵ֣י אָדָ֔ם בִּקְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יָגִֽילוּ׃

controles.web: The humble also will increase their joy in Yahweh, and the poor among men will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
controles.kjv: The meek also shall increase their joy in the Lord, and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
controles.livre: E os mansos terão cada vez mais alegria no SENHOR; e os necessitados entre os homens se alegrarão no Santo de Israel.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־אָפֵ֥ס עָרִ֖יץ וְכָ֣לָה לֵ֑ץ וְנִכְרְת֖וּ כָּל־שֹׁ֥קְדֵי אָֽוֶן׃

controles.web: For the ruthless is brought to nothing, and the scoffer ceases, and all those who are alert to do evil are cut off—
controles.kjv: For the terrible one is brought to nought, and the scorner is consumed, and all that watch for iniquity are cut off:
controles.livre: Pois os violentos serão eliminados, e os zombadores serão consumidos; e todos os que gostam de maldade serão extintos.

versos.hebraico: מַחֲטִיאֵ֤י אָדָם֙ בְּדָבָ֔ר וְלַמּוֹכִ֥יחַ בַּשַּׁ֖עַר יְקֹשׁ֑וּן וַיַּטּ֥וּ בַתֹּ֖הוּ צַדִּֽיק׃ס

controles.web: who cause a person to be indicted by a word, and lay a snare for the arbiter in the gate, and who deprive the innocent of justice with false testimony.
controles.kjv: That make a man an offender for a word, and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate, and turn aside the just for a thing of nought.
controles.livre: Os que acusam aos homens por meio de palavras, e armam ciladas contra quem os repreende na porta da cidade ,e os que prejudicam ao justo.

versos.hebraico: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ית יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּדָ֖ה אֶת־אַבְרָהָ֑ם לֹֽא־עַתָּ֤ה יֵבוֹשׁ֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְלֹ֥א עַתָּ֖ה פָּנָ֥יו יֶחֱוָֽרוּ׃

controles.web: Therefore thus says Yahweh, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob: “Jacob shall no longer be ashamed, neither shall his face grow pale.
controles.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob, Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now wax pale.
controles.livre: Portanto, assim o Senhor DEUS, que libertou a Abraão, diz à casa de Jacó: Jacó não será mais envergonhado, nem seu rosto ficará pálido,

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י בִ֠רְאֹתוֹ יְלָדָ֞יו מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדַ֛י בְּקִרְבּ֖וֹ יַקְדִּ֣ישֽׁוּ שְׁמִ֑י וְהִקְדִּ֨ישׁוּ֙ אֶת־קְד֣וֹשׁ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְאֶת־אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יַעֲרִֽיצוּ׃

controles.web: But when he sees his children, the work of my hands, in the midst of him, they will sanctify my name. Yes, they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and will stand in awe of the God of Israel.
controles.kjv: But when he seeth his children, the work of mine hands, in the midst of him, they shall sanctify my name, and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and shall fear the God of Israel.
controles.livre: Pois quando ele vir seus filhos, obra de minhas mãos, no meio de si, então santificarão ao meu nome; santificarão ao Santo de Jacó, e temerão ao Deus de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וְיָדְע֥וּ תֹֽעֵי־ר֖וּחַ בִּינָ֑ה וְרוֹגְנִ֖ים יִלְמְדוּ־לֶֽקַח׃

controles.web: They also who err in spirit will come to understanding, and those who grumble will receive instruction.”
controles.kjv: They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding, and they that murmured shall learn doctrine.
controles.livre: E os confusos  de espírito virão a ter entendimento, e os murmuradores aprenderão doutrina.
